canonical_data: The user's existing Obsidian vault of local Markdown files, plus an on-disk search and topic-graph index the plugin maintains.
strengths: Hybrid search and the topic graph work fully offline with no AI provider configured
No telemetry; the only network calls are to providers the user configures
Optional agent layer adds skills, memory, and MCP on top of the same vault
Installs directly into an existing Obsidian vault with no migration
weaknesses: Operates as an extension of Obsidian rather than a standalone application
Semantic search and topic modeling require the user to add an embedding model
Started as a university project and is now maintained in the team's spare time
Memory intelligence is search-and-graph clustering rather than deeper temporal or provenance reasoning
why_it_matters: Shows that meaningful offline search and graph intelligence can be added to an existing PKM vault without requiring a hosted model.
